milestone.title: Native multi-ECS lifecycle
milestone.final_goal: Run the complete lifecycle on multiple ECS hosts with directly managed Valkey processes and compatible evidence through exact 200 nodes, building only on a sealed successful M1 completion.

success_conditions.statement: The distributed native-process runtime preserves the admitted local lifecycle semantics.
Host inventory and Valkey process placement are explicit, deterministic, and independently verifiable.
Every directly managed Valkey process has attributable lifecycle and ownership journal records.
Distributed startup, fault handling, recovery, teardown, and cleanup preserve the global safety contract.
Cross-host evidence has attributable clocks, ordering, provenance, and product bindings.
Distributed analysis, resource cost, evidence transfer, and teardown are complete and attributable.
A current trusted capture promoted from M1 proves the complete native multi-ECS lifecycle at exactly 50 observed Valkey nodes.
A current trusted capture promoted from the admitted distributed 50-node result proves the complete native multi-ECS lifecycle at exactly 200 observed Valkey nodes.

real_evidence_requirements.statement: Admit an operator-approved native multi-ECS full-flow capture at exactly 50 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the sealed M1 completion.
Admit an operator-approved native multi-ECS full-flow capture at exactly 200 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the admitted distributed 50-node capture.
